clues: In one research demo, it rendered Apptronik's Apollo humanoid robot playing checkers entirely inside an interactive simulation.
It models physical phenomena like aerodynamics, collisions, and resistance as users steer weather and lighting through text prompts.
Its simulated human characters can engage in interactive spoken dialogue that adapts on the fly to prompts or environmental shifts.
It can sustain interactive sessions lasting up to two minutes, doubling the one-minute threshold set by its predecessor in August 2025.
Rather than compiling pre-rendered video clips, this system computes photorealistic environments frame by frame in real time.
It is Google DeepMind's first real-time world model to generate audio natively alongside visual frames, including dialogue and wind.
